name: Strictly Rhythm
profile:
Prolific New York City-based house label established in 1989 by music executive Mark Finkelstein and A&R [a=Gladys Pizarro].
A&R from 1992 to 1994: [a=DJ Pierre].
A&R from 1992 to the mid-1990s: [a=George Morel].
A&R from 1992 to the late 1990s (and former VP of Promotions): [a=Bari G.]
The label subsequently expanded into Europe where [a=Phil Cheeseman] headed its European operations and was A&R for various UK-based producers.
Other licensing partnerships were established with labels in Germany, France, South Africa, Brazil and Japan.
In addition to its various sub-labels, Strictly Rhythm manufactured and distributed over 30 other labels between 1994 and 2002.
General manager from January 1998 to March 1999: [a=Steve Rosen].
